title: Advancements of mRNA-lipid nanoparticle links to gene editing and immune responses.
one_liner_zh: 综述mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒在基因编辑和免疫应答中的应用，涉及CRISPR-Cas9递送效率，但缺乏对切割/碱基编辑分子机制的研究，仅属工具应用层面。
abstract: Lipid-formulated liposomes have been utilized for the transport of various biological substances, including mRNA molecules. Basically, large lipids play a crucial role in the structure and function of cell membranes. In protein synthesis, mRNA plays a crucial role in expressing the proteins. In this context, this natural process enables gene editing, protein replacement therapy, cancer immunotherapy, cellular reprogramming, and vaccinations. A range of biomaterials is utilized for mRNA transport, including polymers, lipid-based nanoparticles, and protein-mRNA complexes. Thus, the review aims to analyse the mRNA-lipid nanoparticles assigned with gene editing and the mechanisms to enhance immune responses to infectious diseases. A nonviral lipid nanoparticle approach for CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing has achieved up to 80% gene editing in vivo and 98% in vitro across various cancer cell types. MEVPCS-mRNA LNPs, as a preventative HIV vaccine, elicit comparable and highly specific immune responses via CD8+ T cells. Th1-type CD4+ T cell responses are notable in mice immunized with LNP-mRNA, indicating a substantial impact on Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Variations in pH, ionic strength, and freezing rate are essential for enhancing the lyophilization of mRNA lipid nanoparticles. The polydispersity index has risen from 0.1 to 0.3, and the LNP particle size in the Vibrating Membrane Nebulizer has increased from an average of 85 nm to 300 nm, suggesting notable structural degradation due to elevated shear stresses. The Laminar Fluid Ejection Device enhanced the stability of lipid nanoparticles. This enhances the immune response and effectively manages harmful microbes.
abstract_zh: 脂质配制的脂质体已被用于运输多种生物物质，包括mRNA分子。基本上，大脂质在细胞膜的结构和功能中起着关键作用。在蛋白质合成中，mRNA在表达蛋白质方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在此背景下，这一自然过程使得基因编辑、蛋白质替代疗法、癌症免疫疗法、细胞重编程和疫苗接种成为可能。多种生物材料被用于mRNA运输，包括聚合物、基于脂质的纳米颗粒和蛋白质-mRNA复合物。因此，本综述旨在分析用于基因编辑的mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒及其增强对传染病免疫应答的机制。一种用于CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑的非病毒脂质纳米颗粒方法，在多种癌细胞类型中，体内基因编辑效率高达80%，体外达98%。MEVPCS-mRNA LNPs作为预防性HIV疫苗，通过CD8+ T细胞引发可比且高度特异性的免疫应答。在LNP-mRNA免疫的小鼠中，Th1型CD4+ T细胞应答显著，表明对结核分枝杆菌具有实质性影响。pH、离子强度和冷冻速率的变化对于增强mRNA脂质纳米颗粒的冻干过程至关重要。多分散指数从0.1升至0.3，振动膜雾化器中LNP颗粒尺寸从平均85 nm增至300 nm，表明由于高剪切应力导致显著的结构降解。层流喷射装置增强了脂质纳米颗粒的稳定性。这增强了免疫应答并有效管理有害微生物。
